FN-GBHECC-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 72
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/11/2023
Senate Bill 72 as reported by the Committee on Transportation and Energy, beginning July 1,
2023, would allow a judge to order a person charged with driving under the influence and who
participates in a pretrial diversion program or similar program to install an ignition interlock
device. This could impact receipts deposited to the various funds that the ignition interlock fee
is distributed to, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in (1) the number of
individuals required to install an ignition interlock device pursuant to Act 2018-517 (which is
set to expire on July 1, 2023); and (2) the number of individuals ordered to install an ignition
interlock device based upon a finding of a judge.
